question: In Figure 7B-2, what two alternatives are shown for signing the downstream end of the reduced school speed-limit zone?
model_answer: Direct Answer: Figure 7B-2 shows two alternative sign assemblies at the downstream end of the reduced school speed limit zone: an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign or, alternatively, an END SCHOOL ZONE (S5-2) sign. In both alternatives, an optional standard Speed Limit (R2-1) sign showing the downstream speed limit (45 mph in the figure) may be mounted on the same post above the end-of-zone sign. Standards (mandatory): - "Except as provided in Paragraph 4 of this Section, the downstream end of an authorized and posted reduced school speed limit zone shall be identified with an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign (see Figures 7B-1, 7B-2, and 7B-4)." Options (permitted): - "If a reduced school speed limit zone ends at the same point as a designated school zone (see Section 7B.02), an END SCHOOL ZONE (S5-2) sign may be used instead of an END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign. A standard Speed Limit sign showing the speed limit for the section of highway that is downstream from the authorized and posted reduced school speed limit zone may be mounted on the same post above the END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign or the END SCHOOL ZONE (S5-2) sign." - "The downstream end of a designated school zone may be identified with an END SCHOOL ZONE (S5-2) sign (see Figures 7B-1 and 7B-2)." Visual evidence: [Image 1] Figure 7B-2 depicts, at both ends of the zone (for each travel direction), the two alternatives separated by "OR": an S5-3 END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT sign with an optional R2-1 SPEED LIMIT 45 sign above it, or an S5-2 END SCHOOL ZONE sign with an optional R2-1 SPEED LIMIT 45 sign above it. [Image 4] The MUTCD text on this page states the Standard requiring the S5-3 sign at the downstream end and the Option permitting the S5-2 substitution with an optional R2-1 mounted above. [Image 3] Figure 7B-4 shows the same S5-3-or-S5-2 (with optional R2-1) arrangement at the downstream end, confirming the two-alternative pattern. [Image 2] and [Image 5] provide surrounding text on school signing and higher fines zones but do not add detail on the downstream-end alternatives in Figure 7B-2. Citations: - Section 7B.05 Standard §3 (p.978) - Section 7B.05 Option §4 (p.978) - Section 7B.02 Option §7 (p.976) - Figure 7B-2 (p.975) - Page 1020 - Page 1021
gold_answer: An END SCHOOL SPEED LIMIT (S5-3) sign, or an END SCHOOL ZONE (S5-2) sign with a downstream Speed Limit (R2-1) sign shown as optional.
